categories.summary: This Discord chat segment from the #💬-coders channel consists primarily of self-introductions and project announcements rather than technical discussions or problem-solving. Three AI engineers introduced themselves and their capabilities: hyper0672 specializes in AI agents, agentic workflows, model training, RAG, MCP, LLM integrations, and multi-agent systems with full-stack experience; aiden190157 focuses on AI systems, automation, agent-based architectures, backend systems, Unreal Engine, game development, and robotics. Two projects were announced: _am_t_m_ released Neverbell, a new skill providing AI agents with market access, and smolhodler introduced Cipher Vault, a browser-based GameFi demo on Solana Devnet. Cipher Vault features an idle game mechanic where users harvest Soulfire to mint CIPHER tokens, reinforce gates through on-chain SPL token burns (75% burned, rest to house), pay blood tribute (18 CIPHER entry via SPL transfer), and solve daily riddles generated by Eliza, an AI Oracle agent. The game uses wallet-signed SPL transfers on Solana Devnet with Solscan integration for transaction verification. satsbased proposed building a trading agent on Robinhood chain. No technical problems were solved, no debugging occurred, and no architectural decisions were made during this segment. The chat served as a networking and announcement channel rather than a technical collaboration space.

actionItems.description: Build a trading agent on Robinhood chain for the bull market
